column1: # One row per (theorem, side condition, shipped instance). A row says: this
# hypothesis of this theorem is decidable on a fixed program, the evaluator
# `scripts/vacuity/HypothesisInstanceProbe.lean` counts how many bindings of this
# instance satisfy it, and this is what the count is allowed to be.
#   1 theorem     fully qualified name of the conditional theorem
#   2 hypothesis  the evaluator's key for the side condition
#   3 instance    fully qualified name of the shipped program it is evaluated over
#   5 domain      the finite domain the evaluation ranges over, and why it is finite
#   require        the count must be greater than zero. A zero means the theorem
#                  names a situation no shipped program is in.
#   route:<group>  one alternative of a set. At least one row of the group, for
#                  that theorem and instance, must be greater than zero; a group
#                  all of whose rows are zero fails the same way `require` does.
#                  A single zero row inside a live group is printed, not failed:
#                  it records a condition that has stopped carrying any binding.
#   report         measured and printed; decides nothing.
# A row whose instance the evaluator does not measure fails (the registry and the
# evaluator have drifted). A measurement with no row fails the same way. A row
# that must be allowed to measure zero is recorded, with its reason, in
